$comment: Accepted security findings. A finding listed here is suppressed until it expires.
This file is NEVER written automatically, by any code path — an absent or empty
allowlist means nothing is accepted and the gate fails closed. Adding an entry is
Each entry: { id, reason, addedBy, added, expires }
id       the 'allowlist id' printed next to the finding
reason   why this is acceptable — not 'false positive', but why
expires  YYYY-MM-DD. On that date the finding comes back for review.
An accepted risk that never returns is a hole with paperwork.

accepted.reason: GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp (http-cache-semantics <=4.2.0, max-stale on a shared cache). No patched release: 4.2.0 is latest; an unmerged upstream fix is open (kornelski/http-cache-semantics PR #58). The vulnerable code is CachePolicy.evaluateRequest()/satisfiesWithoutRevalidation(). The only importer, astro 7.3.5's build-time remote-image cache (dist/assets/build/remote.js), calls only storable()/timeToLive() on its own fetches and serves nothing to other users; the site uses no astro:assets remote images. The package is absent from apps/web/dist and from the Worker. On expiry: if 4.2.1 is out, refresh the lockfile and delete this entry.
